reviewer: Independent Havenline reference critic; did not build these characters.

companion_results.reviewed: Actual eight-angle imported body, eight phases each for movement/lift/chop, ordinary paid fixture at both camera stops, actual impact and unload receipts. Hair, beard, cross-body strap and satchel, shearling, blue coat, orange elbow patches and boots verified. West stand and unobstructed trunk make both hands and the tool head visible. No exact published companion strike timing inferred.
companion_results.limit: Distant fine stitch and glove contours compress, particularly on the away-side hand. In real early-phase natural occlusion the tool is in front of the character’s chest.

companion_results.item: Expedition owl identity, motion and attack
companion_results.reviewed: Checked native front, flank and rear against the master, plus paid perch at 1x/2x, windup, reach, wolf contact, rake and recover. Clear centered face and ears, blue/orange harness, badge and bedroll, alternating folded-feather bars. The field paid state awards the bird and the current owl hit is emitted at the measured talon contact. Windup and dive each took 15 game ticks at 60 Hz, with 11 ticks in strike.
companion_results.limit: Fine eye/feather marks read at pinch zoom. Rear-facing approach briefly leaves the folded body behind the equipment. The source is a turnaround and does not specify attack timing.
